# gravitino_tag_objects Data Source

Lists the metadata objects a tag is directly attached to. Objects that only inherit the tag are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the metadata objects a tag is directly attached to.
data "gravitino_tag_objects" "pii" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  tag      = "PII"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `tag` (String) The tag name.

### Read-Only

- `objects` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `full_name` (String) The full name of the metadata object, relative to the metalake.
- `type` (String) The metadata object type, canonicalised to the upper-case spelling of the API enum.
